title: Care Desk System Reference — Cancelling Groom Club Monthly
content:
**Applies to.** This rule settles a Groom Club Monthly cancellation at the Tailwise Grooming Salon, which only the customer can make; prepaid passes are refunded under their own rule.

**Rule.** Groom Club Monthly has no full-refund window: a club cancellation is never refunded in full and is settled under this rule. Groom Club Monthly is not refunded for the current month, and a club cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing month, the club closing on its expiry date, the last day of the current billing month. The club cancellation settlement is not fixed until every cancellation on the club that is recorded with a fee remedy carries its club late-cancellation charge entry.

In the terms of the club history: while the salon history of the club shows a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy that has no club late-cancellation charge entry for its booking, the club cancellation settlement is not yet fixed; once every such cancellation carries its entry, it is.

| Salon history of the club | Settlement fixed |
|---|---|
| no cancellation recorded with a fee remedy | yes |
| every cancellation recorded with a fee remedy carries its club late-cancellation charge entry | yes |
| at least one cancellation recorded with a fee remedy without its club late-cancellation charge entry | not yet |

**Cancelling the club: `cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2`**

*What it does.* Cancels the customer's own Groom Club Monthly membership and settles it. One call cancels the club (its status becomes cancelled, no further monthly fee is billed, and the cancellation takes effect on the last day of the current billing month, which is recorded as its closing date), and records one settlement entry in the club history for the settlement amount given, which is collected from the card on file. On success the club shows as cancelled with its closing date and the settlement entry shows the amount collected.

*How it is invoked.* Cancelling is the customer's own act. The agent unlocks `cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2` for the customer and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `groom_pass_id` | reference number of the Groom Club Monthly membership being cancelled, as read out by the care agent from the grooming pass lookup | identifier |
| `settlement_usd` | the club cancellation settlement, in USD, as the care agent states it; 0.00 when nothing is owed | 2 decimal places; the tool keeps exactly 2 decimal places |

*Return.* A confirmation sentence naming the settlement entry reference number (text starting with "cst"), the cancelled club reference number, the closing date as YYYY-MM-DD and the settlement in USD with 2 decimal places collected from the card on file. Receiving it means the club is cancelled and the settlement is recorded.
